```yaml
name: Automated Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: write
  packages: read

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build production assets
        run: npm run build
        env:
          CI: true

      - name: Validate build artifacts
        run: |
          echo "🔍 Validating build artifacts..."
          if [ ! -d "dist" ]; then
            echo "❌ Error: dist/ directory not found after build"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Check for essential files (adjust based on your project structure)
          if [ ! -f "dist/index.html" ] && [ ! -f "dist/main.js" ]; then
            echo "⚠️ Warning: Standard entry points not found, checking for any JS/HTML files"
            file_count=$(find dist -type f \( -name "*.js" -o -name "*.html" \) | wc -l)
            if [ "$file_count" -eq 0 ]; then
              echo "❌ Error: No JavaScript or HTML files found in dist/"
              exit 1
            fi
          fi
          
          # Check file sizes to prevent empty artifacts
          empty_files=$(find dist -type f -empty)
          if [ ! -z "$empty_files" ]; then
            echo "⚠️ Warning: Found empty files in dist/:"
            echo "$empty_files"
          fi
          
          echo "✅ Build validation passed"

      - name: Generate version tag
        id: version
        run: |
          # Generate timestamp-based version tag
          TIMESTAMP=$(date +'%Y.%m.%d-%H%M%S')
          VERSION="v${TIMESTAMP}"
          echo "version=${VERSION}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "🏷️ Generated version tag: ${VERSION}"

      - name: Create Release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v1
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
          name: Release ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
          body: |
            ## Automated Release
            
            This is an automated release generated from the main branch.
            
            **Version:** ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
            **Commit:** ${{ github.sha }}
            
            ### Download Links
            - [Latest Release](https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/releases/latest)
            
            ### Build Info
            - Node.js: 18
            - Build Type: Production
          files: |
            dist/**/*
          draft: false
          prerelease: false

      - name: Log release success
        if: success()
        run: |
          echo "🚀 Release ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }} created successfully!"
          echo "📦 Stable download URL: https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/releases/latest/download/"

      - name: Handle release failure
        if: failure()
        run: |
          echo "❌ Release process failed!"
          echo "🔍 Check previous steps for error details"
          exit 1
```
